notes: Initial focused suites: 121 passed, 2 failed because the isolated CLI fixture HOME hid the installed Bun shim. A project-only rerun retained that harness failure. The fixture now prepends the running Bun executable directory and isolates mise configuration. No product failure remained; final suites: 123 passed, 0 failed, 2070 assertions.

An isolated diagnostic triggered mise downloads under /tmp/pi-fix-cli-home and timed out; that temporary directory was removed. No repository tool configuration changed.
After Pi exited 0 on Ctrl+D, the termscope close request timed out because the protocol had already ended. The captured child_exit event and termscope exit code are 0.
LSP initialization failed because it could not locate TypeScript. Scoped tsc passed. Known unrelated broad bundle compiler failures were not rerun.
GitHub request targeting uses deterministic fixture responses in complete-modal regression tests. No live GitHub service acceptance claim.

The review failures were accepted as ground truth and were not rerun on unchanged source. The actual Pi runtime exercises the fixed SPEC-003 scenario rather than copying the obsolete execution wrapper.
